text: A group of masked men gathered at Union Station today and called for reclaiming the country and getting rid of immigrants. Some held Confederate flags. They have been marching across Capitol Hill.
translated_text: 今天，一群蒙面男子聚集在联合车站，呼吁收复国家并消灭移民。有些人举着邦联旗帜。他们一直在游行穿过国会山。
